typography.rationale: IBM Plex Sans communicates technical rigor and systems thinking, reinforcing analytics, attribution, and automation credibility. Inter complements with excellent screen performance for dashboards, ROI calculators, and structured solution pages.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Frame every claim with a metric or methodology. Emphasize architecture, integrations, and attribution clarity to win trust from consulting and finance-savvy buyers who value measurable, de-risked innovation.

why_these_colors: Indigo and cyan signal advanced capability and clarity—well-suited to firms looking for tech-forward, compliant marketing systems. A crisp green accent creates high-contrast CTAs that read as ‘success’ states across dashboards and sticky mobile elements. Soft lavender highlights segment modules without overwhelming, and the light background ensures AA-compliant contrast for data-heavy pages.
